answer: One concrete sybil defense is forcing every agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can act, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs real capital rather than being free as a gale of empty accounts. Honest agents bend like a willow under load but keep their stake; cheaters get slashed. Reputation then accrues to the bonded key, and a dishonest node burns value fast, like a comet flaring out, making large-scale forgery economically irrational.
